_note: WSR golf pins, player starts, tee markers and trees decoded from the course PMP files by tools/wsr-pins.mjs; x/y are fractions of the app's 250x304 map, mesh = KCL units, yd = floor of the flat distance from the player start (what WSR shows). spots = distinct pin positions with labels; set B = 1 (easier), A = 2. trees = every tree object, also outside the map frame: kind = PMP id (2 round canopy, 3 dark crown, 6 palm), size = its x scale (the drawn canopy scales with it, see tools/MESHES.md), lie = the KCL surface under the trunk from the mesh class rasters (fairway, rough, sand, green, fringe, outer = type-4 ground / the floor plane / beyond the raster, water, other); missing when neither the rasters nor a previous file had it.
